136:t_004:14.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Come on... you could've figured that much out, best buddy.」

136:t_004:15.en:
$$カトル$$
「We just played along with $$ゼロ$$'s act.」

136:t_004:16.en:
$$トロワ$$
「It was improvised, so it was a bit of a stretch.」

136:t_004:17.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「But it was a fine performance, both of you, $$カトル$$ and $$トロワ$$.」

136:t_004:18.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Right. The self-proclaimed master tactician of a commander let his guard down completely.」

136:t_004:19.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Y-you wretches! I noticed that ages ago!」

136:t_004:21.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I'll tell you this: all the $$連邦軍$$ data I gave you is fake.」

136:t_004:23.en:
$$トロワ$$
「For all your claims that you noticed long ago, your emotions showed plainly.」

136:t_004:24.en:
$$デュオ$$
「It was just as $$ゼロ$$ said. If anyone came at Tokyo, it would be some small fry who thinks he's clever.」

136:t_004:25.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Y-you... You made fake data in that short a time!?」

136:t_004:26.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The moment you took the bait of my scheme, I knew the measure of you. All I did after that was prepare a scenario to suit it.」

136:t_004:27.en:
$$玉城$$
「So it was all set up beforehand...!?」

136:t_004:28.en:
$$デュオ$$
「It's been a while since you showed me that, $$ゼロ$$. Your magic tricks.」

136:t_004:29.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「This is no trick at all.」

136:t_004:30.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It is nothing but child's play.」

136:t_004:31.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Silence! Even if I let my guard down a little, I won't be bested by the likes of you!」

136:t_004:32.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$ギルター・ベローネ$$! The match is already decided!」

136:t_004:33.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「You got cocky and were played by my stalling! Thanks to that, every condition has been met!」

136:t_005:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting, $$ゼロ$$, everyone! I brought reinforcements!」

136:t_005:3.en:
$$オットー$$
「Phew... Looks like we made it in time.」

136:t_005:5.en:
$n
「That man $$ギルター$$... He was just being toyed with in the palm of $$ゼロ$$'s hand.」

136:t_005:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Heh... He's as nasty as ever, that $$ゼロ$$.」

136:t_005:7.en:
$$スザク$$
「But as an ally, you couldn't ask for anyone more reassuring.」

136:t_005:8.en:
$$ギルター$$
「$$ゼロ$$! Don't underestimate $$ギルター・ベローネ$$! I have a trump card ready of my own!」

136:t_005:9.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I'll send out every $$インセクト$$ I had on standby!」

136:t_006:0.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「So many $$インセクト$$ soldiers...!」

136:t_008:1.en:
$$デュオ$$
「That guy! I thought he was slacking off, but he was on standby the whole time!」

136:t_008:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I'm leaving it to you, $$ヒイロ$$.」

136:t_009:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I-impossible! Wiped out in a single blow!?」

136:t_009:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「It all went according to $$ゼロ$$'s script. You were only made to dance.」

136:t_009:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Deliberately create a thinly defended front, and make you pour all your remaining forces into it...」

136:t_009:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And then put $$ヒイロ$$ there and wipe them out in one stroke. To the very end, you stayed within my calculations, $$ギルター$$.」

136:t_009:4.en:
$$ゼクス$$
($$ゼロ$$ entrusted the linchpin of the operation to $$ヒイロ$$, and $$ヒイロ$$ trusted the plan and fulfilled his role...)

136:t_009:5.en:
$$ゼクス$$
(So there is a bond between people who have come through countless battles together...)

136:t_009:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「You never prepared to be shot yourself, and you have gunned down people from behind overwhelming power. $c will bring you down!」

136:t_009:8.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, begin the attack! Press them all at once!」

136:t_010:0.en:
$n
「I'll back you up, $$ヒイロ$$! Let's finish this quickly!」

136:t_011:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「Here we go, $$サイデリアル$$! I won't let you do whatever you want with this Tokyo!」

136:t_011:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$ギルター・ベローネ$$! Learn the people's anger!」

136:t_012:1.en:
$$デュオ$$
「I wondered at first how this would go, but we managed.」

136:t_012:2.en:
$$カトル$$
「This victory came down to the difference in commanders.」

136:t_012:3.en:
$$デュオ$$
「I'd like some credit for the rest of us who backed him up, too.」

136:t_012:4.en:
$$トロワ$$
「True. But we can't compare to $$玉城$$, who gave such a convincing performance of rage.」

136:t_012:6.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「It seems best to just leave it at that.」

136:t_012:7.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Well... all's well that ends well.」

136:t_012:8.en:
$$カレン$$
($$シャーリー$$, $$ロロ$$... I managed to protect the place of your memories somehow...)

136:t_012:9.en:
$n
「Come to think of it, $$カレン$$'s school is in this city too, isn't it?」

136:t_012:10.en:
$$カレン$$
「It's not just me. $$スザク$$, $$ヒイロ$$, $$デュオ$$, $$沙慈$$... and $$ゼロ$$ went there, too.」

136:t_012:11.en:
$$デュオ$$
「And that's not all. It's also the alma mater of Miss $$リリーナ$$ and Vice Foreign Minister $$ナナリー$$.」

136:t_012:12.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Come to think of it, that's quite a lineup...」

136:t_012:13.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I see... So this is where $$沙慈$$ and $$ルイス$$ met.」

136:t_012:16.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(But those memories are what make me who I am now.)

136:t_012:17.en:
$$ゼロ$$
($$シャーリー$$, $$ロロ$$... I swear to you...)

136:t_012:18.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(I am $$ゼロ$$... I will surely work a miracle and bring peace back to the world...)

136:t_013:1.en:
$$デュオ$$
「This kind of fight is $$ウイングゼロ$$'s specialty.」

136:t_014:1.en:
$$カトル$$
「As expected of you, $$トロワ$$.」

136:t_014:2.en:
$$トロワ$$
「It's not my achievement. It's the power of $$ヘビーアームズ$$.」

136:t_015:1.en:
$$ノイン$$
「Annihilating only the enemy so the city takes no damage... As expected of you, $$ゼクス$$.」

136:t_015:2.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「With this city's reconstruction, the $$ゼロ・レクイエム$$ has become a thing of the past... That is exactly why I want to protect it to the end.」
